issue: Headline overlaps the Grid (23%) because both defaulted into the same center band, so the 'mould' cluster and the type collide.
rootCause: Grid and Circle were placed at position center, which is the band the renderer gives the headline; the caption also sat at bottomLeft, leaving no separate band for the object cluster.
changesMade: Moved Grid to the bottom band (offsetY -6) so it sits entirely below the headline block.
Moved the gold Circle to the same bottom anchor (offsetY -14, offsetX 4) so it shares the grid's anchor and reads as breaking out of it.
Moved the caption Label to topRight (align right) to free the bottom band from a second text object.
Kept headline typography, accent word, grid contrast lift (opacity 0.95, density 0.85), delays and timing unchanged.
preserve: Typography style: 96px w900 uppercase headline, left align, single accent word DICIPTAIN
objectDominant composition family: type block above, grid+circle cluster as dominant object
Motion family: stagger entrance, subtleScale emphasis at 4.05, fade exit
Color discipline: single gold accent, no added glow, #0B1313 background
VO timing and 9s duration (entranceAt 0, emphasisAt 4.05, exitAt 8.2)
Caption text TETAP UTUH — TANPA DIPAKSA
expectedEffect: The type block and the grid cluster now occupy separate bands, eliminating the collision while the gold circle punching through a high-contrast grid carries the 'intact shape versus uniform mould' beat.
